WITH 
-- Step 1: Point cloud metrics per scan record (join pointcloud to scans for zoneref)
pc AS (
    SELECT 
        s.zoneref,
        p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm'::numeric as scan_resol_mm,
        p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct'::numeric as cover_pct,
        p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct'::numeric as lap_pct,
        p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db'::numeric as noise_db,
        p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense'::numeric as point_dense
    FROM pointcloud p
    JOIN scans s ON p.crewref = s.crewref AND p.arcref = s.arcref
),
-- Step 2: Compute SCE per pointcloud record
pc_sce AS (
    SELECT *,
        cover_pct * (1.0 + (lap_pct / 100.0) * (1.0 - cover_pct / 100.0)) as sce_value
    FROM pc
),
-- Step 3: Compute SRI and SQS per pointcloud record
pc_sqs AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN log(point_dense) > 0 THEN (log(10, scan_resol_mm * 1000.0) / log(10, point_dense)) * 5.0
            ELSE NULL
        END as sri_value,
        CASE 
            WHEN log(point_dense) > 0 THEN 
                POWER(10.0 / ((log(10, scan_resol_mm * 1000.0) / log(10, point_dense)) * 5.0), 1.5) 
                * (sce_value / 100.0) 
                * POWER(1.0 - noise_db / 30.0, 2)
            ELSE NULL
        END as sqs_value
    FROM pc_sce
),
